content:
Last weekend at San Diego Comic-Con, Apple TV announced a slew of news, including the premiere date for the fourth season of *Silo*.

*Silo* season 4 will debut in the summer of 2027 and will be the show's final season.

*Silo* season 3 is currently airing (you can watch it here), with new episodes dropping weekly until September 4.

But at San Diego Comic-Con over the weekend, Apple surprised *Silo* fans alongside news of several other sci-fi series.

*Silo* season 4 will arrive next summer, bringing the series to a close.

Below is the announcement Apple TV posted on X:

In the streaming era, it can take years for a show to come back with a new season, especially a big-budget sci-fi series like *Silo*.

Apple, however, has been aggressive, speeding up the return of some of its shows by renewing them early. For *Silo*, seasons 3 and 4 were prepped simultaneously and shot back-to-back.

We still have six weeks to savor new episodes of *Silo*. But fans won't have to wait long after this season ends, since season 4 will arrive shortly after.

What are your thoughts on *Silo* season 3 so far? Drop them in the comments below.

Apple TV costs $12.99 per month, but you can get a discount by bundling it with Apple One.
